jobs.description:
Here at Scout Motors, we're carrying forward the heritage of one of the most iconic American vehicles in history. A vehicle dating back to 1960. One that forged the path for future generations of rugged SUVs and trucks and will do so once again.

But Scout is more than just a brand, it’s a legacy steeped in a culture of exploration, caretaking, and hard work.

The Scout brand is all about respect. Respect for the past and the future by taking an iconic American brand that hasn’t been around for a while, electrifying it, digitizing it, and loading it with American innovation. Respect for communities by creating a company that stands for its people and its customers. Respect for both work and play, with vehicles that are equally at home at a camp site, a job site, or on a Tuesday commute. And respect for our customers by developing two powertrains that meet their requirements — an all-electric powertrain as well as the Harvester™ range extender powertrain which includes a built-in gas-powered generator with an estimated 500 miles of combined range.

At Scout Motors, we empower our talented, inclusive, and entrepreneurial teams to innovate. What makes a Scout employee? Someone who is a visionary and a leader, who seeks new paths and shares lessons learned. A knowledgeable doer who collaborates across the company to build better. A go-getter with unrivaled passion.

Join us at Scout Motors and be part of shaping the future of transportation. If you're ready to drive change and make history, apply now!

What you’ll do

Become part of an iconic brand that is set to revolutionize the electric pick-up truck & rugged SUV marketplace by achieving the following:

Perform technical planning across multiple technology domains (compute, storage, client, network, physical cable management, production asset management, and infrastructure components) throughout factory
Create and maintain Technology Architecture documentation for transparency
Integrate manufacturing technology solutions into Scout cybersecurity strategy
Create Infrastructure and Hardware Lifecycle Plans
Assess requirements and deliver solutions in accordance with the Production business requirements
Work with production stakeholders to determine the expected level of performance and risks with new processes and systems. Create, with the business area, continuous improvement plans addressing Mean Time to Recovery objectives 
Project management and track assigned technology portfolio necessary to ensure operational readiness for factory operations
Identify, prototype, and test automated solutions which support business process maturity or improvement
Support continuous improvement processes on the production floor.
Identify Automated Solutions which promote self-healing and self-service technologies to support business process maturity or improvement

Ensure monitoring and visualization capabilities are made available to support teams to aid in efficient recovery if an issue is encountered.
Maintain up-to-date knowledge of industry trends, technology advancements, and best practices related to manufacturing systems

This role will be based out of the Scout Motors location in Columbia, South Carolina.

Applicants should expect that the role will require the ability to convene with Scout colleagues in person and travel to participate in events on behalf of the company from time to time.

You’ll be comfortable with change and flexible in a fast-paced, high-growth environment. You’ll take a collaborative approach to achieve ambitious goals. Here's what else you'll bring:

Ability to prepare, organize, and present technical decision papers to upper management
Broad knowledge, both logical (configuration) and physical (compute), of various technologies domains
Good working knowledge of ITIL Service Design, Transition, and Operations
Experience working across manufacturing business domains
Deep understanding of system integration technologies between hardware technologies and software solutions

Proven track record of deploying and moving solutions to operational readiness in a 24/7 production environment.
Experience working with monitoring solutions to provide transparency to business and supporting other responsible stakeholders
Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to troubleshoot and resolve system-related issues, then develop improved solutions to mitigate or eliminate issue recurrence.
Ability to translate high level needs into architecture requirements, then communicating these requirements to technical and non-technical audiences.
Innovative mindset with ability to think outside the box and deliver, when necessary, temporary solutions to meet emergency demands.
Excellent communication, planning and organizational skills.

What you'll gain

The benefits of joining Scout include the chance to build products and a company from the ground up. This is a chance to create something new and lasting – with an iconic brand at its foundation. In addition, Scout provides competitive compensation and benefits to support your physical, mental, and financial wellbeing. jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
About us

Nexl is a fast-growing LegalTech company on a mission to elevate the business of law. The company builds an AI-driven CRM and growth intelligence platform that brings a firm’s internal and external data together so lawyers, marketing teams, and business development teams can collaborate, spot opportunities, and grow revenue.

Nexl has been recognised by the Financial Times, Deloitte, and the Australian Financial Review as one of the fastest-growing companies in the region, is trusted by 150+ law firms globally, and recently closed a $23M USD Series B led by Tidemark Capital.

The Opportunity

Nexl is hiring a Client Success Manager to join our North American client success team: someone who can turn law firm business development expertise into real, hands-on guidance for lawyers as they adopt the platform. This is a senior, client-facing role built for someone who has law firm BD experience (as a BD Manager, Director, or Specialist) and knows first-hand how lawyers build relationships and grow business.

You’ll own onboarding, adoption, and renewal for your North American book of business, and you’ll carry real training responsibility: running client calls and live sessions that help lawyers not just use Nexl, but apply stronger BD practice through it. This is a subject-matter-expert role, not a content-design one: you bring the law-firm BD credibility and run the sessions, while a dedicated L&D function owns the broader training program and materials. You’ll work in an AI-first environment, using AI tools to automate repetitive workflows, prepare client-facing materials, and identify patterns across your book of business. You’ll partner closely with law firm BD leaders, CMOs, and lawyers, as well as Nexl’s Support, Technical, Product, and Marketing teams.

Consulting experience is a strong plus, particularly if you’ve made the move from a senior law firm BD role into an advisory context. If you’ve been part of a law firm’s BD function and want to turn that experience into helping firms actually adopt and grow with technology, this role is for you.

What You’ll Own & Do:

Manage a portfolio of North American law firm clients, acting as their primary point of contact post-sale.
Lead structured onboarding experiences that drive early adoption and set clients up for long-term success.
Run client calls and live training sessions with lawyers, translating the Nexl platform and BD best practice into guidance they can apply immediately. This is a core, ongoing part of the role.
Conduct regular business reviews with key stakeholders, tracking progress, surfacing insights, and identifying growth opportunities.
Monitor product usage, health scores, and engagement signals to proactively maintain client retention rates..
Drive renewals and expansion revenue by demonstrating ongoing value and aligning Nexl’s roadmap to client priorities.
Use AI tools to automate repetitive workflows, prepare client-facing materials, and identify patterns across your book of business.
Act as the voice of the customer internally, feeding insights to Product, Marketing, and Sales.

What We're Looking For:

Must haves:
Several years inside a law firm’s business development function (as a BD Manager, Director, or Specialist), with first-hand understanding of how lawyers build relationships and grow business.
Comfortable operating at a senior level with law firm stakeholders, ideally from B2B SaaS Customer Success, Account Management, or a similar advisory background.
Confident running live client calls and training sessions with lawyers, translating platform functionality and BD practice into practical, applied guidance.
Comfortable using technology to support BD and growth initiatives, and can speak credibly to lawyers about how it fits their day-to-day.
Strong commercial awareness: understands retention, expansion, and the metrics that matter.
Actively uses AI tools to elevate the quality and speed of client-facing work and portfolio management.
Demonstrates strong initiative and ownership, collaborating with others to navigate ambiguity, identify solutions, and move priorities forward.

Nice to haves:
Consulting experience, particularly a move from a senior law firm BD role into an advisory or consulting context.
Familiarity with CRM, relationship intelligence, or workflow automation platforms.
Experience working remotely across a distributed North American team.
Background in change management or digital transformation projects.

What Success Looks Like:

Client portfolio health scores are strong and improving, with low churn and high NPS across your North American book.
Lawyers you train visibly apply BD practice through Nexl, not just navigate the software.
Onboarding experiences are consistently delivering measurable early adoption and time-to-value.
Renewal and expansion rates are above target, driven by clearly demonstrated ROI.
You help build a Client Success function at Nexl that is proactive, commercially accountable, and a genuine competitive advantage.

Life at Nexl

Remote-first. Work remotely by default, with the flexibility to build your week around what works best for you and your team.
High growth. A scaling environment with autonomy, ownership, and visible impact.
ESOP. Employee stock options so you share in the upside.
Work from anywhere. Spend up to four weeks a year working remotely from a location of your choice.
Birthday leave. Take a paid "Nexl Day" during the week of your birthday.
Parental leave. Paid leave to support you and your family as it grows.
Transparent by default. Biweekly all-hands with strategy, metrics, wins, and learnings.
Tools & tech. Modern, AI-first ways of working to help you move faster and smarter, plus a work laptop.

Our Values

Committed to Care – We genuinely care about the work we do and the industry we do it for
Human at the Core – Relationships and empathy guide everything we do
Different with Purpose – We’re not afraid to stand out. We innovate boldly and deliberately

Even if you don't tick every box, Nexl would still love to hear from people who are excited by the mission and believe they would thrive in a high-growth, high-accountability environment.
